quest.title: Duel Before the Throne
quest.description: Kujou Sara storms towards Tenshukaku in a fury. You realize that this is your chance to meet the Raiden Shogun again, but an unexpected yet familiar figure greets you before the throne...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x925, Primogem x30, Mora x44000, Funerary Mask x1, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

dialogues.speaker: Signora
dialogues.text: The way people charge in here as they please... So uncivilized.

dialogues.speaker: Signora
dialogues.text: If I didn't know this was Tenshukaku, I might have mistaken it for some kind of street market.

dialogues.speaker: Signora
dialogues.text: Have you learned your lesson now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, what has she done to Kujou Sara...

dialogues.speaker: Raiden Shogun
dialogues.text: The right to punish Inazumans for their crimes is mine alone. Not yours, Signora.

dialogues.speaker: Signora
dialogues.text: ...Then I apologize, Almighty Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Signora!

dialogues.speaker: Signora
dialogues.text: I know, I know, you can't get me out of your mind. But you really don't need to call my name all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Signora
dialogues.text: Don't go thinking I'm surprised to see you here. I'm well aware that you hate me, with the way you follow me around like a dark shadow.

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: Ah, so you came to expose my crimes in front of the Shogun?

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: Hehehe... I'm just a Snezhnayan diplomat. I'm afraid I have no idea what you're talking about.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She doesn't take us seriously at all...

choices.text: For all who have lost their Visions...

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: Stop talking about people and things that I care nothing about.

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: They were nobodies to begin with, and their names will be forgotten. But now, at least, they get to be building blocks in the grand revolution to realize eternity...

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: Is that not the greatest honor they could hope for in their tiny little lives?

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: Almighty Shogun... do correct me if I'm wrong?

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: That's ancient history. You certainly love to hold a grudge.

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: The Tsaritsa's dream is the noblest and purest thing in all the world.

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: These other mundane details you insist on mentioning... They're just necessary sacrifices. That's all.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's time for me to put a stop to this.

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: You? Stop me? Hahaha...

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: For what it's worth, I've grown tired of seeing you around as well. But I didn't have you down as someone quite so foolhardy.

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: Before you go saying something you can't take back, remember that you're Inazuma's most wanted criminal... I suggest you consider your circumstances very carefully.

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: Charging into Tenshukaku uninvited and lecturing me in front of the Shogun wasn't the brightest move. Don't you think it's time you stopped digging?

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: I'm not sure you realize quite how much distance there is between us, both in status... and in strength.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I challenge you...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...To a duel before the throne!

response.speaker: Raiden Shogun
response.text: Proceed.

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: My, you're full of surprises today... So you've learned to make the law of the land work for you too, hmm?

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: I'll admit that I never expected to be in a situation where the two of us were on equal footing.

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: You are aware... that the loser must die? Are you sure this is what you want?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Signora
response.text: Hehehe... then I will deign to share this last dance with you... till death do us part.

choices.text: And for the people of Liyue you imperiled...
For all who have been harmed by Delusions...
You're trying to seize control of Inazuma...

talks.objective: Defeat Signora in a duel before the throne

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Takayuki
dialogues.text: As long as we have the Musou no Hitotachi, the people of Inazuma have nothing to fear. A self-evident fact, yet Sara is blind to it... Hmph.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: The Lantern Rite celebrations are getting better by the year. Such wonderful music...

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Dr. Baizhu, I've brought the herbs. Who are they for?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: The singers.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Performing at a music festival is very demanding. Using these herbs in good time will protect their voices from damage.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Oh... that's why you were preparing them all night.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Hehe, I dared not neglect the Yuheng's request. Her messenger was quite insistent that it should take top priority.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Let me double-check again... This one is for...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Granny, you play so beautifully! Do you think you could teach me?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh, child, you simply never stop, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: This festival is a rare chance to rest and relax, but here you are pestering me to teach you this, that, and the other...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Granny, I'm a fast learner!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: And anyway, the sooner I start learning, the sooner we'll be able to perform a duet together.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: A musical duo is only as good as its weakest link, so you gotta teach me all your secrets, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Alright, alright... Well, you can start by making me some more tea, and leaving it to cool on the side.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Sure, Granny!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Okay, now I need to get a move on and write my next song!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Listen to you, you only just fulfilled one lifetime dream. Are you really thinking about your next goal already?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Don't try to tell me you ain't the same way. I bet you've already thought up a name for your next opera, haven't ya?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Hehe... You know me too well, Xinyan.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: "The Adeptus-Seeking Voyage"... How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Aw, man! Yeah, I can already picture it!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I've also got just the finishing line for it! I will close with: "And the celestial melody echoed through the clouds forevermore."

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Magnificent... Absolutely magnificent...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Yes... When I heard the music coming from up in the clouds, I was so stunned, I could barely think or move.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: I felt like it had a special kind of hold over me... Hmm, or maybe it was the adeptal power within the music?

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: And the ensemble at the end was truly sublime! I felt like I would have started to cry if I hadn't been one of the performers on the stage.

choices.text: What are your plans for the future?

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Well, Lady Ningguang, the Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing, has invited me to visit her again at Yujing Terrace to discuss a long-term collaboration plan.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: I do hope everything goes well, and that we have more opportunities to collaborate in the future.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: The next time we have another performance, you'll have to come! I will save the best seat for you.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Haha... I have already given her my thanks in person.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: This is what she said: "It is only natural to lend a hand when we see someone in distress. The wonderful music you brought to Liyue is worth far more than gratitude."

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Truly, I felt so honored...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: But I've also made a decision for myself: I will strive to create even more wonderful, original music for this era... our era!

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: #We couldn't have accomplished all of this without you, {NICKNAME}. Please accept my most heartfelt thanks again!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I'm so happy! And all the grandmas and grandpas in Qingce Village had a great time, too.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: You mean... what am I doing here? Well, just now, I did a performance for everyone!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Although I can't play an instrument anywhere near as well as Master, I can still sing.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Even Granny Ruoxin said I did a great job. She also gave me some candies, hee-hee!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Master's told me a lot of stories about the adepti!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: There was Skybracer with the giant deer horns, and Sea Gazer who loved to collect treasure...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Sometimes, Master talks and talks for a long time, until her voice starts to sound sad. But then she always breaks into a smile again, and tells me all of the things each of them loved best about Liyue...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I love everything about Liyue!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Some of the adepti are gone now, but it's okay, because I'm gonna help take care of everyone in their stead!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I'm happy that Mr. Dvorak found the fairy lady from his story. And I'm also happy that it turned out it was Master all along.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Also, I helped out this time too, didn't I? So that means I was... paying "ho-ma-ge" to my master?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Oh, oh, also, Mr. Dvorak got one of his friends to bring me a toy from Fontaine! I like it a lot!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: At first... I didn't know whether I was supposed to accept it or not... But then Master said it was okay, so I did!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: See you! Make sure you take good care of Paimon!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Oh, and please come play with me if you ever have the time!

dialogues.speaker: Zhaoqin
dialogues.text: People in our line of work get real busy during the holidays.

dialogues.speaker: Zhaoqin
dialogues.text: My mom is going to nag my ear off when I get home.

dialogues.speaker: Zhaoqin
dialogues.text: Maybe I should buy some gifts to bring back... Eh, no. It's not going to work. Dad's going to accuse me of being wasteful with Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Zhaoqin
dialogues.text: Agh, what a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Huixing
dialogues.text: Sea conditions are consistent and there are no other vessels in target waters... Hmmm... very suitable for kicking off "Vigilance at Sea"!

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Okay! Be sure to give it your all!

choices.text: About the difficulty of "Vigilance at Sea"...

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: I would like to ask you guys: how did you guys find the challenge?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon thought it wasn't too hard. This kind of test is a piece of cake for Paimon and {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Well, considering how formidable you two are, this sounds about right.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Thanks for your feedback. Now I know a little more! I'm going to have to think a little bit more about how to adjust the difficulty curve for both challenge and pass rate...

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: The four major certificates and the five minor certificates? Simple.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: The four major certificates consist of the "Fit for Sailing Certificate," the "Ship Maintenance Aptitude Certificate," the "Power Maintenance Aptitude Certificate," and the "Survivability at Sea Certificate."

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: The five minor certificates consist of the "Basic Safety Certificate," the "Lifeboat Certificate," the "Fire Safety Certificate," the "First Aid Certificate," and the "Monster-Precaution Certificate."

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: With all these certificates, a sailor is equipped to solve most of the problems of navigation.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Although the crew may not understand the principle of each request, they just need to remember the main points of the task and follow the instructions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This doesn't sound simple at all!

choices.text: And we still haven't gotten into the details yet...

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: No worries! With your talent, you can sail smoothly without having to bother with all the technical details!

choices.text: I should consult Beidou when I have the chance...

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: Okay! The Captain is a bit of a straight shooter. You'll probably become experts after asking her!

choices.text: I need some time to prepare.

response.speaker: Huixing
response.text: I understand! You guys are measured and careful, so you guys might need some more time. I trust you guys!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: You're back, esteemed ones! How was the racing challenge?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We had a good time, and we feel great!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: A good time? That's good to hear! I would try it myself if I was stronger.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe you should keep training, Tiantian! A strong recruiter is sure to bring more people in!

choices.text: The gunpowder gave Paimon a boost!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We set a record for the fastest time, and none of the other participants could catch up with us!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Ah, I'm starting to get excited myself! Maybe I could outdo you as the creator of this event?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehehe, that won't be easy. Maybe if you actually design a gunpowder-propelled backpack, maybe you might have a chance!

choices.text: We want to try it again. Goodbye!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Bye! I'll be here awaiting your feedback!

dialogues.speaker: Yinggong
dialogues.text: So, are you guys ready?

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, I present to you — Homeward, Bravebeard!

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Don't worry. It's only natural to be a bit nervous.

dialogues.speaker: Hesheng
dialogues.text: I've seen Bravebeard so many times, to the point where I can memorize every line!

dialogues.speaker: Hesheng
dialogues.text: But don't worry. I won't spoil the story. I'm way better than that.

dialogues.speaker: Qingxing
dialogues.text: Why is the Bravebeard so formidable? I wish I could be as strong as him.

dialogues.speaker: Yinggong
dialogues.text: Back so soon after the performance? Maybe you want to give it another go?

choices.text: I want to see it again.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Haha, it seems you really enjoy this. Let's do an extra performance then.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: No special performance has been planned for this year's Lantern Rite. After all, we've already performed for many years' Lantern Rite in succession. So this year, we can finally have a good rest.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: That said, I started getting a little restless and decided to put on a paper play for the kids, haha.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Goodbye for now. When we meet again, I shall show you the costumes and props I've made.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The vegetables are fresh, and there are enough wheats and grains stocked up... I'll pass on the seafood.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. We meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Surprised to see me here?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It's the director's orders. Xiangling worked all day and night at the restaurant during the festival and didn't get to have any time to enjoy the festivities. The director sent me here to help out in the kitchen so that Xiangling will have some time to herself.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: But with someone as hardworking as you around, there seems to be nothing much for me to do...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It feels good seeing my old friend in the kitchen fetching ingredients and lighting fires.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Perhaps I should borrow Cloud Retainer's supreme cuisine machine to speed things up...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: ...You'd still prefer to make them by hand? But of course.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: This is such a cool ship!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Facing the sea breeze and gazing out at the soaring seagulls... Ah, makes me wanna sing out loud!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Kazuha, how about I stay here and be the ship's resident bard? What are my prospects?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: With your level of artistic finesse, I'm sure nothing will go wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But I'm afraid the sailors aboard are not the most versed in the arts. They probably wouldn't understand the deeper meaning your poetry holds.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Haha, you can't say that for sure! Poetry is spur-of-the-moment creations. Anyone viewing the same sights and experiencing the same atmosphere would surely understand.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: *sigh* There's a port in Mondstadt too, but I rarely get the chance to board any of the ships.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Speaking of ships, everything's perfect about this one, except...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Um, Kazuha...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Could you tell your Captain that my height says nothing of my age? I'm way past drinking age.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: How often does one get to enjoy a seafood feast on a ship? It'll be a real shame if there isn't anything stronger to enhance the food! Pretty please?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: There's... not much I can do about that.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It's not because Captain Beidou's not on the ship right now, but because there's no room for negotiation on this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Even I have to sit in the no-drinking zone every time.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: *whimper* But I don't get drunk after just a few sips... Trust me, I can hold my liquor really well!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hey, don't tell me you called me over just for a game of chess.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: You have to be more specific, Captain Beidou.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Is it that you find playing chess an uninteresting activity, or that you're unhappy about my lack of novel ideas?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: If you don't specify what you mean, how could I know what I should do to please you?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Heh, of course...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I make a single remark and you reply with a full-blown lecture.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Maybe we should deal with all official affairs publicly in the future. Might just make things easier.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I'd be perfectly happy with that — I'm just worried that Captain Beidou's business might be negatively affected.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Don't give me that.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: That woman from Yanshang Teahouse sometimes comes aboard to ask for information. She requested the fleet to import some goods, but how could I not know who she's actually working for?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Oh? You sure know a lot, Captain Beidou.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: How about I ask her to come over? Or maybe we go straight to her Teahouse?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: With one more person around, we'll be able to have some variety in our chess games. I hope that that would be less of a bore to you.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Tsk, so we're still going to play chess after all!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Hehe, Xingqiu, you have to be honest.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Hm? Honest about what?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: How did you and Venti really meet?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Wh—Why are you suddenly asking that...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Eh? Aren't they book buddies?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Yeah! We met a few times at a book convention, that's all...

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Ohh? Really?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: With that extraordinary demeanor and literary talent, he's definitely not just any bard.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: If he's someone that could hold his ground in a conversation with the consultant, he needs to at least be as talented as me!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Um, perhaps you're overthinking this matter...

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Ah...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hu Tao, Xingqiu wouldn't lie to us...

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: *sigh* Okay, I'll tell you the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Xingqiu...!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: I'm actually a fan of Venti's poetry.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: You all know that I love reading, and sometimes come across poetry from Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Among those works, I admire the ones penned by Venti the most. Just as Hu Tao said, his artistry is the reflection of his personality — remarkable grace and exceptional literary talent.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: I guess Venti didn't tell you the whole truth back at the restaurant because he didn't want to embarrass me in front of everyone... He's such a considerate person.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: ...Yes, right. I can confirm that.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: When Xingqiu was busy with other things, he asked me to buy him poetry books in secret.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: That didn't sound like too much of a big deal. You could've told us right away.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Well, I'm telling you now, aren't I?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Oh... So that's your story...

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: ...Ah, forget it. Let's drop this topic.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: It's not often that the four of us are all together. What should we do next? Hide-and-seek, hopscotch, or some shopping?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Since there's four of us... Why don't we borrow a mahjong set?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Yanxiao just came up here with some Almond Tofu, but... I haven't finished everything Xiangling gave me yet...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You should try some too. I'm not as experienced in tasting mortal food as you, and I couldn't tell the difference.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...There must be many different stories to tell of the hustle and bustle of the mortal world, too. You can tell me. I will listen.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Heh, doubtless, the city is more festive.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: The heroes we commemorate during Lantern Rite are actually adepti who lived in Liyue in the distant past.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Do you know which adeptus the Mingxiao Lantern commemorates this year?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I asked around for information, and a gentleman who looked very knowledgeable told me that the adeptus' name is Sea Gazer.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: He is said to be a collector of exotic treasures. I'm sure an adeptus like him will bless everyone with wealth and prosperity.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Things feel more or less the same, year after year...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Not that it's a bad thing. Though nothing particularly good happened, there was nothing bad either.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: I hope next year will go smoothly as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Oh my, if it isn't my old acquaintance. Did you come all this way during Lantern Rite just to see me?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: It's been a while, but you still look as lovely as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Ah, it's the Lantern Rite, but I don't really have much time to spare. Can't help it when the shop's so popular, you know? Otherwise...

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: ...Hehe, anyway, why don't you feast your eyes on what we've got in store? Who knows, you might chance upon some extra benefits.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: I mean, I'm just a slap of lipstick and a dab of makeup compared to those beauties.

dialogues.speaker: Chen the Sharp
dialogues.text: Hey there, are you here to sight-see and have some fun? If you're hungry, wanna grab a couple of freshly-grilled Tiger Fish?

dialogues.speaker: Chen the Sharp
dialogues.text: Even the adepti love it! Get it while it's hot!

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: Festivals, eh? Well, it's nice and all. The lights are pretty, and things are livelier than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: But you know, it's not like it's got all that much to do with me...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Hello, hello... Uh, I mean...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Ahem. Happy Lantern Rite! May you stay healthy and hale, and may all go well with you!

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Haha, I guess I've finally gotten used to the festive greetings that locals give one another...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Hi, I'm Linlang. I run an antiques shop called Xigu Antiques... How may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Entry registration forms for foreign ships, additional material requirements for stage construction, and... Wait, what are you doing!?

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: When is Daddy coming back? Is it too late to write him and ask for a flute?

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Manager Kuan, I wanna hear a song. Sing a song for me!

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Firstly, for the umpteenth time, just call me "Daddy."

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: No! And don't try to change the subject.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: It's a music festival, so everyone should be playing music or singing!

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Playing music is a little too difficult for you, Manager Kuan, but you should at least sing something!

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: I'm not a singer, I'm just Manager Kuan... No, wait, I'm your Daddy!

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Since you're my Daddy, wouldn't it be natural that you'd be better than me?

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Even I can sing a few lines... Lalala~... lala~!

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: If Manager Kuan can't sing better than me, how can he be my Daddy?

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Hello, welcome to Liyue, and welcome to the Lantern Rite Festival!

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: You must have heard about the music festival held in collaboration with the Iridescence Tour during this year's Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: I hope everyone can have a good time during the festival and enjoy the musical atmosphere.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Of course, for civil matters, please go to the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Hey, this is the big day! The annual Lantern Rite is finally here!

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: You see, seeing all of Liyue Harbor this lively is quite a rare sight.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: And for the finale of this year's Lantern Rite, they'll be holding a musical performance!

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: It's also said to have something to do with Fontaine's renowned Iridescence Tour!

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: I heard they haven't done a show in a while, so this one can't be missed!

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: The glow of Xiao Lanterns fills the night sky, shedding light on lands below as they fly. The lighting of the stage dances before one's eyes, as a sea of people are singing together...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Yes, yes...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Have you heard? This year's Lantern Rite has a new event: a musical performance!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: If you want to fit in, you should talk about music.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: But it's hard to attract an audience when you have a romantic atmosphere without a powerful scene...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Do you think it's possible to combine singing and fighting?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: Winning a battle while being accompanied by a dynamic rhythm... Yeah, I think that's a good idea.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: You wouldn't be able to hear of this story from my fellow, Tea Master Liu Su. All he does is talk about dry, prissy, genteel stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Phew... Lantern Rite is such a tiring time. I should take a moment to rest...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: But the moment I stop, the anxiety just hits me all over again...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: After all, Lady Yuheng has assigned a new task for the music festival, so I still can't rest...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Hello. I... you... cat... ATCHOO!

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... After hearing that there'll be a music festival, people sometimes come to the pier to play and sing...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: The cats around them got scared and ran around, shedding their fur everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: I... cats... aaa... ATCHOO!

dialogues.speaker: Sisi
dialogues.text: Oh hello, if it's an invitation to go to a musical performance, I'm afraid I must decline. There's someone I'm waiting for.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: I didn't know that you liked music so much... I'm so glad I invited you here.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: And thank you for inviting me. I've never had such a great time enjoying live music...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I don't know much about music, but with the person beside— Ahem, with all these people around, it's been a great experience.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: That's great! You've always been a quiet person, so I was afraid you wouldn't like this kind of event.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Looks like I should keep an eye out for more music festivals like this in the future...

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: The glow of the Xiao Lanterns feels so warm...

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: And I don't know if it's because of the music festival performance, but the stage lights made the lantern even brighter.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: This blazing heat ignites a nostalgic flame in me...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Have you seen the music festival? The resounding echoes are sure to reach places farther than the Xiao Lanterns do...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: ...Perhaps you'll even be able to hear the music from atop the hills of Qingce Village.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* Little Liu... I miss you so much...

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Why, hello there. How may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: If this is about work, please allow me to decline for now. This festive season is quite hard to come by after all. Feeling the sea breeze, listening to the music... It is all ever so pleasant...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Lantern Rite music festival...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: There's usually a familiar sense of nostalgia in the air during the Lantern Rite, and it complements my store perfectly.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: This year's Lantern Rite music festival, however, has brought along some new ideas.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: People may become interested in music-related antiques, so I should probably read up on related legends too...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: After all, every ancient object that has weathered the ages has a fascinating story to tell.
